Test Case: E2E-01 Add, edit and remove minutes
Test data / Preconditions: N has no active degradation; base customer SLA 30 and fulfillment SLA 20; Express ON; configured +15 and +30 options; future end time.
Steps: In Create New select only N; submit +15 with configured reason and end time; wait for city completion; verify readers; edit to +30; then remove and wait for completion.
Expected: Base remains 30/20; effective values are 45/35 then 60/50 (not 75/65), then return to 30/20; active list and audit history reflect the actions and timestamps.

Test Case: E2E-02 Create New replaces an active increase
Test data / Preconditions: N has active +15 and known base values; configured +30 option.
Steps: Create a new +30 degradation for N through the UI; wait for completion; remove the latest setting.
Expected: Effective values are base plus 30 once; removing it returns to base and does not revive +15; each accepted Add may have a distinct operation ID.

Test Case: E2E-03 Temporary Express OFF replaces minutes and vice versa
Test data / Preconditions: N has Express ON; eligible scheduled slot fixture; no other state changes.
Steps: Apply +15 then replace with OFF; check readers and customer slots; remove OFF. Repeat starting with OFF and replacing it with +15.
Expected: OFF disables Express and Super Express and exposes base SLA values; separately eligible scheduled slots remain available; removing OFF returns to base; replacing OFF with +15 uses the base setting and does not restore an earlier event.

Test Case: E2E-04 Super Express uses effective settings
Test data / Preconditions: S is Super Express ON with recorded base values; valid stock, hours and capacity.
Steps: Check baseline, then +15, edit extent, OFF and Remove on S using hub-slot, availability/validation and ATP paths.
Expected: Applicable paths use effective KML settings; no fixed Super Express SLA substitutes for them; OFF suppresses Express and Super Express; Remove restores S's recorded base. Dynamic ETA need not equal base SLA exactly.

Test Case: E2E-05 Base customer and fulfillment values change while degraded
Test data / Preconditions: N has +15 active; base customer SLA 30 and fulfillment SLA 20.
Steps: Edit base values to 40/25 in KML Slots Config; save and reopen; check readers; remove degradation.
Expected: Form displays base 40/25; effective values while degraded are 55/40; after removal values are 40/25; base edit does not add another degradation.

Test Case: E2E-06 Base Express OFF cancels active degradation
Test data / Preconditions: N has an active increase; O is a base Express OFF fixture.
Steps: Turn base Express OFF for N; inspect readers and history; turn it ON again; inspect Create New eligibility for O. Separately exercise queued Add racing with base OFF under controlled engineering setup.
Expected: Base OFF and cancellation commit together; turning base Express ON does not revive the event; O is excluded from Add targets; a queued Add that becomes ineligible is skipped even if its city operation completes.

Test Case: E2E-07 Expiry returns to current base
Test data / Preconditions: N has an active degradation with a short future end time; second run replaces longer-lived +15 with shorter-lived +30.
Steps: Wait for end time to pass; refresh Active and effective readers; repeat for replacement case.
Expected: Effective reads use current base at expiry; older +15 never resumes; no restoration job or user action is needed; expiry creates no new operation and existing operation history remains.

Test Case: E2E-08 Multiple areas and multiple cities
Test data / Preconditions: N and N2 are eligible in one city; C2 is eligible in another; record hubs including shared hubs.
Steps: Select N and N2 through filters and submit; inspect operation details; submit a second operation for N and C2; use Bulk Remove for selected areas.
Expected: One-city operation has one city result and two-city operation has two; selected areas are covered and unrelated areas unchanged; distinct hub counts are correct; city results may finish at different times; no separate bulk-create action is needed.

Test Case: E2E-09 Dynamic and non-dynamic hub behavior
Test data / Preconditions: D and ND have confirmed dynamic and non-dynamic promise paths; save KML effective and Promise/debug baselines.
Steps: On both fixtures run baseline, +15, base edit, OFF and Remove; capture KML and Promise/debug fields after each state.
Expected: Increase is applied once to the appropriate calculation; fallback does not add it again; OFF is not overridden by live ETA; routing, inventory and capacity rules remain in effect; ATP behavior is not toggled by is-dynamic-promise header.

Test data / Preconditions: QA customer app/site access; stocked basket; address inside N or S; record client version and experiment cohort.

Expected: Failed city has no partial event updates; other committed cities remain valid; exactly one current row remains when history exists including Remove/expiry; never-event KML may have no current row; unique operation/KML application is maintained.

Test data / Preconditions: Queued Add racing with base OFF, base SLA edit and soft deletion; controlled concurrent Edit and Add.

Expected: Eligibility is reread after base lock; base-OFF/deleted targets are not revived; base writes serialize; a later consumed Add may supersede synchronous Edit as specified.

Test Case: REL-05 Whole-transaction retry and uncertain commit
Test data / Preconditions: Controlled transient SQL/deadlock/lock-timeout fault and uncertain commit; primary SQL tracking access.
Steps: Inject transient failure; observe attempts and state rereads; simulate uncertain commit; inspect tracking row before any resume.
Expected: Whole transaction retries up to configured limit (LLD states at most three attempts) with bounded backoff and reacquired locks; terminal tracking result is not overwritten; acknowledgement follows known outcome.

Test data / Preconditions: Configured queue deadline; Add with end time passing before consumption; Add and Remove delayed beyond deadline.

Expected: No late event applies; queue deadline is checked after lock waits; configured timeout is used (15 minutes is a default, not assumed QA setting).

Test data / Preconditions: Controlled loss of in-memory dispatch before publication; stale Pending operation; restart/rebalance setup.

Test data / Preconditions: Successful Add/Edit/Remove, AUTO and base-OFF cancellation; skipped, rolled-back, expired and redelivered cases.
